_about: Runtime settings, created next to the app on first run. my_name: your pilot name as shown in game. monitor: 1 = primary. fps: lance-panel reads per second. full_every: seconds between full-frame reads. panel_region / target_region: the lance panel and the target info panel as fractions of the game window. ocr_dml: use the GPU (DirectML) instead of the CPU. ocr_threads: CPU threads for OCR. donate_url: the support link shown in the app.
